answer.text: Brokerage + STT + bid-ask + impact cost + capital gains tax

explanation.text: The Logic: Full cost stack: direct (brokerage, STT, stamp) + indirect (bid-ask, impact cost) + tax (capital gains). All erode returns. The Trap: Understanding all cost layers is crucial for rebalancing ROI. Cross-Exam Context: Practical PM. Manager's Pro-Tip: TCA (Transaction Cost Analysis) quantifies impact cost — especially for larger PMS books.
